Job Details: 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact 
 Join a team helping shape the future of high-performance CPU design. As an AI/ML CAD Engineer supporting RTL and Design Verification , you will develop and enhance automation, tools, and methodologies that help engineering teams design and validate advanced microprocessors.

 You will combine software engineering, CAD/EDA, RTL and verification knowledge, and AI-assisted development to improve front-end design workflows spanning RTL development, simulation, verification, emulation, static sign-off, and CI/CD.

 This is an opportunity to apply strong programming and problem-solving skills to complex CPU development challenges while helping introduce AI-enabled capabilities that improve engineering productivity and efficiency.

 What You'll Do 
 Key responsibilities will include but not limited to: 
 Troubleshoot issues across RTL, EDA Frontend tools (VC_SPYGLASS(Lint, CDC and RDC), VCS, VMS) and automation infrastructure, and design environments.
 Develop, deploy, and maintain AI-assisted CAD/EDA automation, tools, and workflows supporting RTL design and verification.
 Build scripts and software solutions that improve RTL build, simulation, verification, emulation, regression, and static sign-off workflows.
 Apply AI/ML and AI-assisted development technologies to improve engineering automation, debugging, and productivity.
 Develop and enhance CI/CD and regression automation for hardware development workflows.
 Analyze workflow and infrastructure data to identify opportunities for improved performance, reliability, and engineering efficiency.
 Partner with engineering and cloud infrastructure teams to improve compute utilization and scalability.
 Collaborate with RTL design, verification, CAD, infrastructure teams, and EDA vendors to resolve technical issues and improve methodologies.

 Behavioral traits that we are looking for: 
 Technical curiosity: Enjoys learning new technologies and finding better ways to solve engineering challenges.
 Problem solving: Uses structured analysis and sound judgment to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
 Collaboration: Works effectively across design, verification, software, infrastructure, and vendor teams.
 Communication: Clearly communicates technical issues, recommendations, and solutions to different audiences.
 Ownership: Takes responsibility for deliverables and follows issues through resolution.
 Adaptability: Comfortable learning and working across evolving AI, software, and semiconductor design technologies.
 
 Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. 
  See  Intel Benefits  for more details. 
 
 
 Qualifications: 
 You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.  Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.

 Note: 
 For information on Intel’s immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see 
 Intel U.S. Immigration Sponsorship Information 
   
 Minimum Qualifications and Experience :

 Bachelor's in Electrical or Computer Engineering or Computer Science + 3+ years of experience, or a Master's in the same field with  1+ years of educational or work experience . 
 Your experience describe above must be in the following: 
 Linux experience with shell scripting.
 Python, Perl, or C/C++ skills
 RTL/Verification CAD tools
 Debugging across RTL, automation flows, and software/tool interactions.
  
 Preferred Qualifications and Experience: 
 Troubleshoot EDA tools and design environments
 Experience with major EDA tools (VC_SpyGlass, VCS, Questasim, coverage/low-power tools).
 Experience with CAD/EDA automation (simulation/emulation flows, verification integration, CI/CD).
 Experience with AI Development environments such as GitHub/Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor.
 Experience supporting RTL build and simulation/verification workflows.
 Experience working with EDA vendors (issue triage, features, debugging).
 Multi-domain debugging (RTL, testbench, tools, scripts, infrastructure).
 Cloud compute experience (scaling sim farms, resource optimization).
 DevOps for hardware (regressions, CI/CD, monitoring/alerting).
 Verilog/SystemVerilog.
 
           
 
 
 Job Type:
Experienced Hire 
 
 Shift:
Shift 1 (United States of America) 
 
 Primary Location: 
US, Texas, Austin 
 
 Additional Locations:
US, Oregon, Hillsboro
